ValidationRule.description: Field "Date Code Formats" is required when Production Code is filled.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(NOT( ISBLANK( Production_code__c ) ), ISPICKVAL(Country_For_Partial_Decoding__c ,''), ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'US'), NOT( AND(ISCHANGED(OwnerId),LEFT(PRIORVALUE(OwnerId),3) ='00G') ), $User.FirstName <>'System')
